def evolved_p93(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Debug: return reference values computed straightforwardly with python ints,
    # then build tensor via torch.tensor to check correctness independent of bit tricks.
    vals = [i ^ (i >> 1) for i in range(N)]
    t = torch.tensor(vals, device=x.device)
    return t.to(x.dtype)
